title: Research methodology and provenance
overview: A small explicit weight intervention is evaluated on instruction following and, separately, a fixed browser resource workload. Historical V1 quality, adaptive V2 development and the new all-edit resource pilot remain distinct. Lower token counts do not establish lower memory, computation or energy.

model.name: Qwen3.5-0.8B

architecture.deployed_scope: Text backbone; vision and MTP excluded

model.coordinate_count_note: Stored aliases and buffers included; not independent trainable parameters.
model.intervention_scope: Weight values change; tensor shapes, parameter count, bit width and compiled graph remain fixed. No smaller architecture or sparse inference kernel is introduced. Output length and runtime behavior can affect measured resource use.

studies.title: V1 historical quality
studies.question: Does the frozen edit improve instruction compliance on the selected evaluation subset?
studies.scope: 32 development prompts; selected 128-prompt / 173-instruction Google IFEval evaluation subset. Not the full benchmark.
studies.selection_rule: Candidate frozen before the final comparison; final observations did not choose the edit.
limitations: Strict 69/128 versus 70/128; difference +0.78125 percentage points, paired 95% interval −5.46875 to +7.03125 points. Improvement and equivalence are unestablished.
Candidate final execution was interrupted after 94 outputs and separately continued for 34 undispatched suffix items.
Final prompts are now exposed; historical outcomes cannot become new untouched confirmation.

sources.label: V1 reproduction and exact source pins

studies.title: V2 adaptive development search
studies.question: Can Astra produce strict compliance above 16/32 using at most 13,941 sampled output tokens?
studies.scope: Three actual Astra proposals evaluated on the same 32-prompt Ai2 RLVR-IFeval development set against the saved pristine baseline; no untouched final prompts.
studies.selection_rule: Require strict > 16/32, tokens ≤ 13,941 and complete technical validation. Rank strict compliance, then fewer tokens, then earlier round; pristine wins quality ties.
limitations: All three candidates scored strict 16/32 and loose 17/32. Pristine was retained under the frozen rule.
One adaptive editor trajectory; three fresh agents are not independent editor replications.
Historical baseline Chrome 156.0.8078.80 versus candidates 157.0.8103.39 prevents isolated weight-only causal attribution.
The original conditional resource comparison was skipped; the separately authorized all-edit pilot does not reopen this selection.

studies.title: All-edit resource pilot
studies.question: How do pristine and every completed edit compare on the same current browser resource workload?
studies.scope: Five artifacts × two browser sessions; 60 fixed-prompt measured requests per session. Quality qualification is not required. See the separate result for actual completion status.

generation_settings.public_workload_prompt: In three short sentences, explain why leaves change color in autumn.

studies.selection_rule: Include all five frozen deployed artifacts regardless of development quality; do not select retrospectively from resource outcomes.
studies.replication_unit: Browser session; two planned sessions per artifact
studies.analysis: Publish both session values and mean/minimum/maximum; descriptive differences from pristine only. Missing or invalid required measurements yield null, not zero.
limitations: Mirrored order balances a linear trend in session position, not necessarily elapsed time when durations differ. It is not randomized or fully counterbalanced and does not eliminate nonlinear drift or carryover.
One device and two sessions per artifact; 60 repeated fixed-prompt requests are not 60 independent experiments or a quality benchmark sample.
No significance, equivalence, general efficiency or fresh quality-preservation claim.
Fresh browser profile and IndexedDB do not imply a cold operating-system disk cache.
The historical Chrome-version mismatch concerns quality; the current resource environment is independently checked for matching.
Lower CPU/GPU activity or power rates with longer responses do not establish lower cumulative computation or energy; compare duration and coverage.
studies.public_workload_prompt: In three short sentences, explain why leaves change color in autumn.
studies.aggregation: Compute each metric within each session first, then report both values and their equal-weight arithmetic mean/minimum/maximum. Artifact throughput is the mean of the two session throughput ratios, not pooled tokens divided by pooled seconds. Independently averaged throughput and milliseconds per token need not be reciprocals.

editor_provenance.feedback: Approved weight information, 32 development tasks, saved baseline outputs/grades and preceding candidate feedback. No new final-quality outcomes were supplied. Round 3 packet delivery continued without new scientific feedback.

v1_final.exposure: Now exposed; not reusable as new untouched confirmation

resource.public_workload_prompt: In three short sentences, explain why leaves change color in autumn.

scoring.strict_prompt: All instructions in the prompt must pass official strict checks.
scoring.strict_instruction: Passing instructions divided by scheduled instructions.
scoring.loose: Official IFEval loose alternatives; secondary metric.
scoring.reasoning_policy: Extract answer after complete leading think block; no answer repair.
scoring.v1_uncertainty: 10,000 paired prompt-cluster percentile bootstrap samples; seed 0, lexicographic item order and linear quantiles; not an equivalence test.

scored_output_tokens.label: Sampled output tokens
scored_output_tokens.definition: Sum across measured requests; excludes warm-up and four injected boundary IDs.
scored_output_tokens.limitations: Different output lengths mean different realized work.

response_ms_sum.label: Total response time
response_ms_sum.definition: Sum of browser wall time around measured completion calls, including prefill and decode.
response_ms_sum.limitations: Excludes load, warm-up and idle gaps; not full-session or decode-only time.

response_ms_per_output_token.label: Response time per sampled token
response_ms_per_output_token.definition: Within each session: summed response milliseconds divided by sampled output tokens. Across sessions: equal-weight mean of the two session values; it need not be the inverse of mean throughput.
response_ms_per_output_token.limitations: Includes prefill overhead; output-length differences affect normalization.

load_ms.label: Model load time
load_ms.limitations: Separate from warm-up and session timing; browser cache policy does not guarantee a cold operating-system cache.

session_ms.label: Profile session time
session_ms.definition: Total measured profile duration, including prescribed baseline, idle and recovery phases.
session_ms.limitations: Separate from response time and controller-stage ledger time.

native_peak_footprint_gb.label: Peak accounted process footprint
native_peak_footprint_gb.definition: Maximum sampled sum of per-process ri_phys_footprint during the profile, divided by 1e9.
native_peak_footprint_gb.limitations: Not globally deduplicated physical RAM; do not add GPU descriptors, WASM address space or RSS.

native_idle_footprint_gb.label: Final loaded-idle footprint
native_idle_footprint_gb.definition: Median sampled footprint in the idle phase after the final active window.
native_idle_footprint_gb.limitations: A retained-memory observation, not all machine memory.

native_recovery_footprint_gb.label: Recovery footprint
native_recovery_footprint_gb.limitations: A remaining level, not the amount of memory freed.

cpu_capacity_percent.label: CPU capacity
cpu_capacity_percent.definition: Time-weighted complete process-tree CPU intervals divided by logical CPU count.
cpu_capacity_percent.limitations: 100% means total logical CPU capacity under this normalization, not one core. This is an activity rate, not cumulative computation; a lower rate with a longer response does not establish less total work.
cpu_capacity_percent.coverage: Valid, wholly contained active-interval duration divided by total active duration

gpu_time_ms_per_second.label: Experimental GPU time
gpu_time_ms_per_second.definition: Driver-accounted command-buffer time per elapsed second via AGX AppUsage.
gpu_time_ms_per_second.scope: Dedicated Chrome process tree, including rendering
gpu_time_ms_per_second.limitations: Not GPU utilization, occupancy, arithmetic-operation count or model-only time; queues may overlap and counter changes invalidate intervals. This is a rate: lower GPU milliseconds per second with a longer response does not establish less cumulative work.
gpu_time_ms_per_second.coverage: Valid, wholly contained active-interval duration divided by total active duration

gpu_buffer_descriptor_bytes_sampled_max.label: GPU buffer descriptors
gpu_buffer_descriptor_bytes_sampled_max.definition: Sampled maximum of WebGPU buffer descriptor byte accounting.

wasm_address_space_bytes_sampled_max.label: WASM address space
wasm_address_space_bytes_sampled_max.definition: Sampled maximum of WebAssembly linear-memory byte length.
wasm_address_space_bytes_sampled_max.limitations: Not physical residency; do not add to native footprint.

host_power_watts.label: Host subsystem power
host_power_watts.definition: Observed CPU/GPU/ANE subsystem estimate, interval-weighted over valid active intervals.
host_power_watts.limitations: Not wall power or model watts; unprivileged capture may leave it unavailable. Watts are a rate, not energy: lower power with longer duration does not establish lower joules.
host_power_watts.coverage: Valid, wholly contained active-interval duration divided by total active duration

energy.label: Host subsystem energy
energy.definition: Original merger integrates observed power-interval overlap across first-active to last-active bounds; may include between-burst idle.
energy.limitations: Not request-only energy or causal model energy; five-second observed pre-run baseline where available.
energy.coverage: Original observed covered-interval duration; missing intervals are not filled

mean_response_ms.label: Mean response time
mean_response_ms.definition: Summed measured response time divided by measured request count.
mean_response_ms.limitations: A mean within a session does not add independent experimental replicates.

full_response_tokens_per_second.label: End-to-end output throughput
full_response_tokens_per_second.definition: Within each session: summed measured output tokens divided by summed response seconds. Across two sessions: equal-weight arithmetic mean of those two ratios, not a pooled token/second ratio.
full_response_tokens_per_second.limitations: Not a mean of request rates, decode-only throughput or equal work when lengths differ.

preserved_failures: V1 conversion-environment failure and the 94+34 manually continued candidate final evaluation remain documented.
V2 initial sandbox failure generated nothing but consumed one browser attempt; only three real candidate evaluations remained.

V2 round 3 offline grading stopped before any checker call after completed browser output and cleanup. Exact-byte recovery and one 27.657-second offline pass added zero model loads/generations or editor calls. Nineteen harness files, 171 pinned evaluator payloads and four frozen inputs were recovered; 347 unavailable bytecodes were quarantined; the 758/758 frozen-input preflight matched.

The all-artifact resource study stopped after six completed sessions when the position-7 integrity check timed out on an offloaded protected historical file. The failed check charged 28.943 seconds, with no session-7 reservation, model load or generation. The original 10,135 bytes were later ordinarily materialized with the exact frozen hash and no overwrite. A separate continuation is limited to original positions 7–10 under the retained clocks and deadline. The slow second R3 observation and the inter-session gap remain part of the evidence; no uninterrupted run is claimed.
reproduction: Use pinned source model/data revisions and released ordered item IDs; selection reruns without private exclusions may differ.
Reconstruct each independent deterministic source transformation and verify complete source/deployment manifest identities.
Verify current environment, actual fetched model/runtime bytes, per-session manifests and durable accounting before interpreting resource differences.

Public hashes and aggregates support reconstruction and arithmetic audits; withheld raw outputs and private custody records are needed for independent original regrading and editor-access verification.

publication_scope.included: Sanitized metrics, IDs, operations, hashes, methods and verification logic
publication_scope.excluded: Private prompt/response text, editor packets, authorization, credentials, local machine paths and session transcripts
